About Us

Welcome to the Hacker theme for Astro. This is a clean and minimal blog theme that's perfect for any type of blog.

The theme features a responsive design, clean typography, and a simple layout that focuses on your content.

It's built with Astro, a modern static site generator that's fast, efficient, and easy to use.
